title: Maratón de Buenos Aires 42K — official course map displayed on the 2026 page
claims: The official 42K course map displayed on the 2026 page is a 1920×750 image whose file name is Recorrido-42K-2024.jpg.
The map labels the start and finish at Avenida Figueroa Alcorta and Dorrego in Palermo and marks 42 kilometre points along the route.
The map route passes the Planetario, Rosedal, Recoleta, Teatro Colón, Obelisco, Casa Rosada, Puerto Madero, the Reserva Ecológica, La Boca and Boca Juniors before returning to Palermo.
The 2026 page does not publish a separately labelled 2026 course map; the displayed image is the 2024 file, so this page treats it as an official but undated course representation.
